chunks: He said: A man said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'O son of the Messenger of God, how will I know that the Night of Power occurs every year?'
He said: 'When the month of Ramadan comes, recite Surah al-Dukhan once every night. And when the night of the twenty-third comes, you will await the confirmation of what you asked about.'

key_terms.تَصْدِيقِ: Confirmation, attestation — the visible or experiential sign of the Night of Power
key_terms.سُورَةَ الدُّخَانِ: Surah al-Dukhan (Chapter 44, 'The Smoke') — specifically mentioned as the surah to recite
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr (Night of Power/Decree) — the most sacred night of the year, revealed in Quran 97

ai.seo_question: How can one recognize Laylat al-Qadr (Night of Power) each year according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: A man asks Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) how to recognize Laylat al-Qadr each year. The Imam prescribes a practice: recite Surah al-Dukhan (Chapter 44, 'The Smoke') once every night throughout Ramadan, and on the night of the twenty-third, one will witness the fulfillment or confirmation of this blessed night. This teaching reflects the Shia tradition that Laylat al-Qadr falls on the 23rd night of Ramadan, and that consistent recitation of Surah al-Dukhan is a means of spiritual preparation for it.
